card.name: Start of radiology words
card.fires_on: The piece "radi" at the start of radiology, radiologic, radiographic and radiological, especially before imaging tests or procedures. It also fires weakly on other imaging-related word starts like "ven" in veno-occlusive and "Res" in Magnetic Resonance.
